cohort: The study included 905 obstetrics and gynaecology (OBG) patients who underwent selected surgeries (Cesarean Section, Laparoscopic Hysterectomy, Laparoscopic Cystectomy, Laparoscopic Myomectomy, and Laparoscopic Assisted Vaginal Hysterectomy) at a tertiary care teaching hospital in Karnataka, India, between January 2023 and July 2023.
finding: AB-PMJAY provided full coverage with zero out-of-pocket expenditure (OOPE), while private health insurance reduced OOPE but still left a significant financial burden, and uninsured patients incurred 100% OOPE.
